name: korean_multichar_word
why: i18n parity: 4+char Hangul words (데이터베이스, 마이그레이션) tokenize and match; the old ASCII-only class returned [] and scored a hard 0.0.

name: korean_short_nouns
why: script-aware floor: 2-char Hangul nouns 결제 (payment) / 모듈 (module) are kept at len>=2 and match. Under the old len>3 filter this scored 0.0 — the common Korean case the reporter hit.

name: korean_common_verb_prompt
why: a typical Korean request built only on short nouns now matches, closing the gap (was 0.0 with regex-only).

name: spanish_accented_latin
prompt: continuar la migración del módulo de pago
checkpoint: refactor de la migración del módulo de pago
why: accented Latin (migración, módulo) stays whole instead of splitting at the accent into 'dulo'-style fragments.

name: accented_two_char_stays_filtered
why: script-aware floor guard: accented Latin keeps the len>3 English floor, NOT the CJK len>=2. 2-char 'ré'/'tú' are stopword-like and filtered, so this scores 0.0. Pins that a future 'make everything len>=2' change stays red.

name: chinese_identical_run
checkpoint: 继续数据库迁移工作 已完成部分
why: a Han run is captured as one token, so an identical run in the checkpoint matches.

name: cyrillic_short_words
why: Synthetic short Cyrillic topic words are retained in Python, OpenClaw and OpenCode; the previous CJK-only floor discarded both and produced no match.

name: fullwidth_latin_in_japanese
why: Fullwidth Latin sits above U+3000, so a 3-char word like ＡＰＩ is kept by all three runtimes (fixed code-point ranges, no Unicode script tables).

name: cyrillic_function_words_do_not_match
why: 2-letter Cyrillic function words (на, не) are dropped by the len>=3 floor for alphabetic non-Latin scripts, so two unrelated Russian texts do not match on them.

name: ascii_regression
why: Regression guard: pure-ASCII scoring is unchanged by the two-branch tokenizer and the script-aware floor.

name: chinese_segmentation_limit
checkpoint: 支付模块重构 的后续
why: KNOWN LIMIT: Chinese/Japanese have no word spaces, so a whole run only matches an identical run. '继续重构支付模块' != '支付模块重构'. Word-level parity needs morphological segmentation (jieba/mecab) — a tracked follow-up, not this PR.
